sentence: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

sentence: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.

sentence: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

sentence: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

sentence: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9:

sentence: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

sentence: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.

sentence: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).
text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, the levels of broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances measured shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband emissions of a series lamp per Annexes 7 and 8; pass if levels do not exceed the paragraph 6.5.2.1/6.6.2.1 limits by more than 4 dB.
quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).

sentence: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.
text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, the ESA shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
test_case: Expose a series lamp to radiated fields up to 80 % of the Table 2a/2b levels per Annex 9; pass if no observable degradation of lamp functions occurs.
quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.

sentence: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1. above.

sentence: Dipped beams ON (manual mode) | Lighting OFF (front light and rear light)

sentence: Brake pedal not depressed | Unexpected activation of brake and unexpected activation of stop lights

sentence: "Brake mode" vehicle test conditions Failure criteria Vehicle in a state that allows the braking system to operate normally, parking brake released, vehicle speed 0 km/h. text: In the "Brake mode" vehicle immunity test, with the vehicle in a state that allows the braking system to operate normally, parking brake released, vehicle speed 0 km/h and brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle, stop lights inactivated during mode shall be considered a failure.

sentence: Test method This test is intended to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs (e.g. ignition systems, electric motor, onboard battery charging unit, etc.). If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.

quote: Test method This test is intended to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs (e.g. ignition systems, electric motor, onboard battery charging unit, etc.). If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.

sentence: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

sentence: Alternative measuring location As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS), which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to this Annex).

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

sentence: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

sentence: Measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors. The limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors. If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
test_case: Operate each function (rear position, stop, reversing) continuously and verify by photometer/observation that intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.
quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

sentence: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
condition: Lamp intensity varies with ambient light (variable intensity category)
test_case: Vary ambient light conditions and verify each resulting photometric state meets the device regulation limits for the lamp.
quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

sentence: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
condition: Lamp photometry changes when other lamps (e.g. stop lamp) are switched ON or OFF
test_case: Switch other lamps ON/OFF and measure the rear position lamp photometry, confirming each state complies with its device regulation.
quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

sentence: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
condition: Rear position and stop lamp are reciprocally incorporated (shared light sources/emitting surfaces)
test_case: Operate the shared lamp in each function and verify photometry for each function meets its device regulation limits.
quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

sentence: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);
text: To verify paragraph 5.10.1., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Zone 1 sight-line check at 25 m in front of the vehicle and confirm no direct view of the red lamp's apparent surface.
quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

sentence: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);
text: To verify paragraph 5.10.2., for the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
test_case: Confirm the only white lamp in the rear lamp is the reversing lamp (exempt); otherwise perform the Zone 2 check at 25 m behind the vehicle.
quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

sentence: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
test_case: Measure luminous intensity of red light emitted towards the front of the lamp (with vehicle body influence if applicable) and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.
quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

sentence: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except that this requirement does not apply while front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps, side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
test_case: Operate the vehicle lighting switch and verify the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps and rear registration plate lamp, outside the listed exceptions.
quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

sentence: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split across body and tailgate)
test_case: Switch the interdependent lamp system ON and OFF and verify all light sources of all units change state simultaneously.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

sentence: Tell-tale Where a closed-circuit tell-tale is prescribed by this Regulation it may be replaced by an "operating" tell-tale.
text: Where a closed-circuit tell-tale is prescribed by this Regulation it may be replaced by an "operating" tell-tale.
test_case: Check the vehicle tell-tale for the rear position lamps is either a circuit-closed or an operating tell-tale.
quote: Tell-tale Where a closed-circuit tell-tale is prescribed by this Regulation it may be replaced by an "operating" tell-tale.

sentence: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
test_case: Inspect the installed rear lamp and confirm no concealment device covers the rear position, stop or reversing lamps or retro-reflector.
quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Reversing lamp: White ...
text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp light and confirm it lies within the white colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Reversing lamp: White ...

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Stop lamp: Red ...
text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp light and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Stop lamp: Red ...

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear position lamp: Red ...
text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp light and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear position lamp: Red ...

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red ...
text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
test_case: Measure the colour of the light reflected by the retro-reflector and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red ...

sentence: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors fitted on the vehicle and compare with the numbers in the individual specifications.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

sentence: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: Lamp mounted on a movable component (tailgate/boot lid)
test_case: If the lamp is on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

sentence: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
condition: Lamp mounted on a movable component (tailgate/boot lid)
test_case: With the movable component at each fixed position, check position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector.
quote: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

sentence: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
text: In the case where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions installed on movable components are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
condition: Lamp on movable component and function obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D"
test_case: Verify that at least one of the "D" lamps meets position, visibility and photometry at all fixed positions of the movable component.
quote: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.

sentence: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only where additional lamps for these functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
condition: Lamp on movable component using additional lamps switched ON in open position
test_case: With the movable component open, verify the additional lamps are switched ON and meet position, visibility and photometric requirements.
quote: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.

sentence: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or
text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system, should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, except that additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system mounted completely on a movable component
test_case: Verify compliance with 5.18.1 at all fixed positions or that additional lamps switched ON meet all applicable requirements.
quote: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or

sentence: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system, should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) being deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system partly on fixed and partly on movable component
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify the specified interdependent lamp(s) meet position, outward visibility, colour and photometric requirements.
quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

sentence: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
condition: Lamp mounted on a movable component (tailgate/boot lid)
test_case: With the movable component open, assess that the lamps do not cause undue discomfort (glare) to road users.
quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

sentence: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
condition: Lamp is mounted on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid).
test_case: Operate the movable component repeatedly and verify the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position in the normal position of use.
quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

sentence: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
condition: A movable component can hide the lamp or retro-reflector, depending on mounting location.
test_case: Place each movable component in each fixed position and measure the hidden share of the apparent surface along the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent.
quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

sentence: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or
text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
condition: Lamp mounted on or hidden by a movable component and paragraph 5.21 not practicable.
test_case: With the movable component positioned to hide more than 50 per cent, verify additional compliant lamps switch ON.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

sentence: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable and the alternative of paragraph 5.21.1. is not used, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road, except that paragraph 5.21.2. does not apply to retro-reflectors.
condition: Lamp hidden more than 50 per cent by a movable component and 5.21.1 alternative not used.
test_case: Check the vehicle contains the user notice on warning other road users in the relevant movable component positions.
quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

sentence: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark shall be deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
test_case: Verify each lamp function of the installed lamp operates without requiring more than installation of a light source and/or fuse.
quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.

sentence: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources approved to UN R37.
test_case: Replace the light source on the vehicle using only vehicle-supplied tools without expert assistance; pass if correctly replaced.
quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

sentence: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
text: For lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources approved to UN R37.
test_case: Check the vehicle documentation contains a detailed light source replacement procedure.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

sentence: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.
text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
condition: Light source module includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source.
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.

sentence: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
condition: Lamp system provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function.
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and verify the replacement function is similar in colour, main intensity and position while the replacement device keeps its original function.
quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

sentence: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
condition: Lamp system provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function.
test_case: Simulate failure and verify the dashboard tell-tale indicates temporary replacement and need for repair.
quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

sentence: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be allowed, provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable intensity control.
test_case: Vary the triggering conditions and measure intensities; pass if all combined/grouped/reciprocally incorporated lamps vary together in similar proportion.
quote: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

sentence: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable intensity control.
test_case: Measure stop/rear position lamp intensities across the variation range; pass if the prescribed ratio is maintained throughout transitions.
quote: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

sentence: Environmental conditions Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall be allowed in relation to the following environmental conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.
condition: Rear position lamp R2 and/or stop lamp S2 with variable intensity control.
test_case: Verify intensity variation is triggered only by the listed environmental conditions and stays within the limits of the pertinent regulations.
quote: Environmental conditions Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.

sentence: Traffic conditions Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m. However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall be allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, except that as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
condition: Rear position lamp R2 and/or stop lamp S2 with variable intensity control.
test_case: Verify intensity decrease activates only at ≤20 km/h or ≤20 m following distance and is cancelled above 50 km/h.
quote: Traffic conditions Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m. However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.

sentence: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.

sentence: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.

quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.

sentence: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.

sentence: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

quote: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

sentence: Nature of tests Tests of conformity in this Regulation shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.
text: Tests of conformity in this Regulation shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.

sentence: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

sentence: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random: (a) No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.

sentence: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall be contested if the deviation of at least one specimen of samples A or B is more than 20 per cent.

sentence: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability has occurred.

quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.

sentence: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
